name: Bouncy Castle Jakarta S/MIME API
description: The Bouncy Castle Java S/MIME APIs for handling S/MIME protocols. This jar contains S/MIME APIs for JDK 1.5 and up. The APIs can be used in conjunction with a JCE/JCA provider such as the one provided with the Bouncy Castle Cryptography APIs. The Jakarta Mail API and the Jakarta activation framework will also be needed.
